observable: Local marginal probability density of azimuthal velocity, not torque
units: Reference velocity; density per reference velocity
model: Exact stationary unsoftened isochrone, G=M=1, b=0.5
interpretation: Density, mean and all even moments match; higher odd velocity structure differs.
limits: Equation evaluations, not measured dark-matter velocities or simulation frames.
A local marginal is not a torque predictor or a complete distribution function.

evidence.interpretation: Archived record ID, not a raw-array download promise.

release.source_scope: Frozen positive populations, unforced algebra challenge, archived inspection sources and compact saved-response operands.
release.reproduction_scope: The portable NumPy/SciPy replay recomputes six contractions, seed-library intervals, reference uncertainty, covariance and selected paired numerical changes from supplied impulses and stored sampling DF values. It does not regenerate the sampled orbits, the velocity-marginal quadrature, live dynamics or a new forcing history.
release.note: Original archived input/evidence hashes remain unchanged. New release metadata identifies the compact analysis bundle; complete trajectory-array evolution is not supplied.
